_about: The player-owned car lineup (decided 2026-10-18): three ORIGINAL, UNBRANDED designs inspired by a class of real car (never copied: no logos, badges, lettering or plates, and no brand names in any prompt). The modern sedan has its OWN identity (`compacte`: catalogue entry, name, texts, module definition; the old `clando` is retired and migrated to it for existing owners); the sport sedan and the SUV fill the existing `berline` and `tout_terrain` entries (decided 2026-10-18). Each keeps the game's ownership, driving, save, cameras and wheel system: the body is fitted to that slot's kit target (assets-src/vehicles/target-*.json) by scripts/vehicles/prepare-vehicle-glb.mjs. Player-owned only: no NPC vehicle is generated. Nothing is generated until `released` is true AND the step is approved in the environment (scripts/meshy/stage-a.mjs).

briefs.title: Modern sedan
briefs.inspiredBy: a 2020s Hyundai Elantra (class and proportions only)

slot.catalogue: Berline moderne · price PROVISIONAL (economy pass) · tier 2 · its own catalogue entry `compacte`

briefs.role: affordable but stylish: the first car a player can own, attractive but not luxury-tier
briefs.prompt: A compact modern four-door sedan from the 2020s, affordable but stylish, silver-grey metallic paint, clean realistic proportions, long low hood, sloping fastback-style roofline with a short rear deck, sharply creased bodywork with a strong shoulder line, slim angular LED headlights with a sharp light signature, wide lower grille, LED tail lights, about 4.5 m long, 1.8 m wide and 1.4 m tall. Original design, no badges, no logos, no lettering, no number plate text, symmetrical, game asset, neutral studio pose. IMPORTANT: car body only. The four wheel arches are EMPTY and dark. No wheels, no tyres, no rims, no brake discs, no suspension, no ground shadow.
look: plain but tidy: no chrome, no flares
briefs.delivered: 2026-10-18: generated (35 credits), integrated, playable; see docs/assets/VEHICLE_LINEUP.md 1c

briefs.title: Sport sedan
briefs.inspiredBy: a modern Mercedes-AMG sedan (class and proportions only)

slot.catalogue: Berline neuve · 14 000 000 F · tier 3 (marked « soon » until it can be driven)
slot.dealer: to choose (a second lot of the Plateau showroom, or Almadies)

briefs.role: more premium and sporty: must clearly read as an upgrade over the modern sedan at a glance
briefs.prompt: An elegant modern four-door performance saloon, premium and sporty, dark graphite metallic paint, long hood and short rear deck, low wide stance, sleek coupe-like roofline, wide flared wheel arches, pronounced power-dome lines on the hood, slim LED headlights, wide grille with vertical slats, aggressive lower air intakes, clean upscale detailing, subtle rear lip spoiler, quad exhaust outlets, full-width LED tail light strip, about 5.0 m long, 1.9 m wide and 1.45 m tall. Original design, no badges, no logos, no lettering, no number plate text, symmetrical, game asset, neutral studio pose. IMPORTANT: car body only. The four wheel arches are EMPTY and dark. No wheels, no tyres, no rims, no brake discs, no suspension, no ground shadow.
look: longer, lower, wider than the modern sedan
bigger wheel arches (kit wheel radius 0.35 against 0.31)
elegant coupe-like roofline, stronger road presence
cleaner, richer detailing: slatted grille, hood lines, rear light strip

briefs.title: Premium SUV
briefs.inspiredBy: a modern Range Rover (class and proportions only)

slot.catalogue: 4 × 4 de luxe · 75 000 000 F · tier 4 (marked « soon » until it can be driven)

briefs.role: luxury SUV, the top-tier ownership goal: upright, prestigious, strong presence
briefs.prompt: A full-size luxury SUV with an upright, prestigious silhouette, deep black metallic paint, tall clamshell hood, flat floating roofline, clean slab sides with minimal creases and a continuous beltline, slim horizontal LED headlights, wide horizontal-bar grille, short overhangs, large flush wheel arches, near-vertical tailgate, slim LED tail light strip, premium proportions and clean surfaces, about 4.9 m long, 2.0 m wide and 1.9 m tall. Original design, no badges, no logos, no lettering, no number plate text, symmetrical, game asset, neutral studio pose. IMPORTANT: car body only. The four wheel arches are EMPTY and dark. No wheels, no tyres, no rims, no brake discs, no suspension, no ground shadow.
look: tallest and most upright of the three (1.90 m)
largest wheels (kit radius 0.39) and most ground clearance
flat roof, clean slab surfaces, minimal ornament
dark, quiet, expensive: presence from proportion, not decoration
